EC2: - Presenting systemic pathology [OR] and / or taking medication that may affect the periodontal situation [OR] and / or patients requiring antibiotic prophylaxis.
EC3: - Have received systemic antimicrobial treatment in the previous 6 months.
EC4: - Have received periodontal treatment in the 6 months prior to the beginning of the study.
EC5: - Patients allergic to metronidazole, [OR] or to any of the components of commercial formulations thereof (Flagyl®).
EC6: - Patients allergic to azithromycin, [OR] or to any of the components of commercial formulations thereof (Zithromax®).
EC7: - Patients who refuse to sign the informed consent.
